lines.text: Ren! The sign is counting again. Look, the little one on the end is moving.
It counts all the time. You just noticed.

choices.text: Explain what the sign is for

lines.text: It counts the Steps everyone has left. Yours, mine, the whole street's.
Mine runs out first. That is what older brothers are for.
You are not even that much older.
I saved these for you. Do not tell Mother, she will say I am wasting them.
Ten Steps, warm from her pocket.
I will keep them somewhere safe.
Keep them where you can reach them, is the point.
You still owe me a photo. A real one, with the whole street in it.
Stand by the sign. Not in front of it.
She stands very still, the way children do when they are being brave.
Do I look like I am not scared?
You look like the street belongs to you.
Will you take the long road or the short one?
That is not what I asked.
